words.example: Remove every obsolete version so staff do not follow the old steps.
words.exampleZh: 请撤下每一份作废版本，免得员工还按旧步骤做。

words.example: A controlled document has to show its version and its keeper.
words.exampleZh: 受控文件必须标明版本和保管人。

words.example: An uncontrolled copy must be marked so nobody files it by mistake.
words.exampleZh: 非受控副本必须标明，免得有人误把它归档。

words.example: The master copy of the signed minutes stays in the locked drawer.
words.exampleZh: 签过字的纪要正本放在上锁的抽屉里。

words.example: Mark your working copy clearly so nobody files it as the original.
words.exampleZh: 请把你的工作副本标清楚，免得有人当成原件归档。

words.example: The send connector for the bureau uses the city mail gateway.
words.exampleZh: 发往卫健委的发送连接器走市里的邮件网关。

words.example: The receive connector allows mail only from the laboratory subnet.
words.exampleZh: 接收连接器只接收检验子网发来的邮件。

words.example: The accepted domain list now includes the new clinic email suffix.
words.exampleZh: 接受域名清单里现在有了新门诊的邮箱后缀。

words.example: Our authoritative domain covers every staff address at the hospital.
words.exampleZh: 我们的权威域名覆盖本院每一个员工邮箱地址。

words.example: The internal relay domain accepts partner mail and passes it on.
words.exampleZh: 内部中继域名收下合作方邮件，再继续往下投。
